script: In 1908, a huge explosion flattened a forest in Siberia. It knocked down about 80 million trees over more than 2,000 square kilometers. Scientists think a space rock exploded in the air above the area. Because it blew up before hitting the ground, it left no big crater. The blast was hundreds of times stronger than the Hiroshima bomb. Follow WonderBytes for more facts that sound fake but are true.
